# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\\lichii\\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lichii/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
# Beside-application files accept EDEN_NX2_* and the emulator's diagnostic switches only.
# Host environment settings, including library paths such as EDEN_STREAMLINE_DIR, must be
# set in the real environment or the user configuration file at an absolute config location.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Duskbloods render-accuracy experiment ---
# Enabled only for The Duskbloods Network Test title ID. Set to 0 to opt out.
EDEN_NX2_DUSK_ACCURACY=1

# Run the GPU in-order; do not use the second GPU execution thread or frame overlap.
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=0
EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=0

# Trade performance for conservative memory synchronization and readback diagnostics.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=0
EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1
EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
EDEN_NX2_PERF_VERIFY=1
EDEN_NX2_READ_CHECK=1
EDEN_NX2_DMA_READ_VERIFY=1
EDEN_NX2_BACKX_VERIFY=1

# Preserve the existing Duskbloods temporal-weight workaround.
EDEN_NX2_TEMPORAL_WEIGHT=1

# --- Other Switch 2 defaults ---
# These remain opt-in for this experimental Duskbloods-only branch.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1
#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
